findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：直銷組織占總營收 78%（2025、2024 皆 78%，2023 為 79%），其餘透過 MSP 與轉售夥伴；通路結構近三年穩定。
findings.excerpt: Revenues from our direct sales organization represented 78% of our total revenues for each of the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024 and 79% of our total revenues for the year ended December 31, 2023.

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：以訂閱協議銷售，部分 AI 與資料方案另含超出訂閱服務點數後的用量計價成分。
findings.excerpt: In addition to subscription offerings, certain AI and data solutions include a consumption-based pricing component that governs when customer usage exceeds the fixed number of service credits available under the customer’s subscription agreement.
